scope: Explicit FastAPI, Celery-worker, database-CLI, project-schema, and workflow-graph schema initialization boundaries. No service, container, network, provider, configured application database, or PostgreSQL instance was contacted.

semantic_boundary.core: Stable schema lock identity and ordered bootstrap intent.
semantic_boundary.effect_shell: SQLAlchemy transaction, PostgreSQL lock timeout and transaction-scoped advisory lock, DDL execution, rollback, and Celery worker termination.
ordered_composition: commit on success or rollback on failure
failure_observations: development FastAPI or worker bootstrap logs and returns false
production Celery child converts the re-raised exception to WorkerTerminate(1)
database CLI preflight always propagates failure and does not invoke the wrapped command
a failed DDL transaction publishes no partial transaction and releases the advisory lock through rollback

checks.evidence: worker_process_init has a strong receiver; the receiver calls the explicit initializer without import-time DDL; WorkerTerminate is a BaseException and therefore is not swallowed by Celery Signal.send's Exception handler.
initialize_database_cli and run_database_cli perform the fail-closed full project-schema preflight before invoking a command; a negative test proves a failed preflight prevents command execution.
checks.ceiling: This establishes the reusable general boundary. Historical standalone scripts that bypass both this wrapper and ensure_project_schema_ready are not silently claimed as migrated.

checks.evidence: FastAPI schema creation, project CLI table creation, shared/public startup DDL, and both workflow-graph SQL store constructors use one schema-scoped transaction advisory-lock interpreter. Unit tests verify lock-before-DDL ordering, common public-schema ownership, bounded lock timeout, rollback-visible failure, and retry.
checks.ceiling: PostgreSQL server behavior was not exercised.

checks.guard: MRW_TEST_POSTGRES_URL must be PostgreSQL on localhost and the database name must start with mrw_test_.
checks.expected_observation: One process acquires the lock, performs DDL and fails; six waiting processes then initialize successfully; the failed row is absent while all successful rows are present.

verification.ruff_shared_dirty_files: PASS with pre-existing E501, UP017 and UP034 excluded
